scaler_fitted_on: Output Train only; input identity after per-trial initial-distance division
input_normalization: Per-trial first recorded distance ratio; no secondary input scaling
physical_normalization: Current index MCP Euclidean distance / first recorded frame distance
output_normalization: Train-only Z-score; predictions restored to mm
mlp_short_history: Causal left padding by first real value within each continuous sequence
lstm_short_history: Use all available real frames; no padding/repetition
state_policy: Reset at trial start, missing/invalid input OR target, nonconsecutive frame, nonpositive dt or dt>0.10s
physical_processing: No velocity, time normalization, per-trial amplitude normalization, smoothing or interpolation

models.Function: one scalar current distance -> current aperture; fixed spline lambda=1e-6
models.MLP 100f: 100 distances oldest-to-current (causal first-value left padding for short history) -> Linear(100,32), ReLU, Dropout(.1), Linear(32,32), ReLU, Linear(32,1)
models.LSTM 5f: LSTM(1,32), Dropout(.1), Linear(32,1); independent rolling windows of up to 5 frames; zero state each window

fairness: Same common five-consecutive-frame targets for fitting losses and main scoring. LSTM consumes at most 5 consecutive real inputs per target; separate from-start metrics.
loss: MAE; equal loss weight per experiment; Adam lr=0.001 weight_decay=0.0001
selection: Fixed 400 epochs, last epoch only; Function fit once on Train; Test evaluated only after fitting all models.
